questions.question: Write the IUPAC name of: CH₃CH(OH)CH₂CH₃
questions.solution:
Longest chain: 4 carbons = butane
OH on C-2 → **Butan-2-ol**
questions.knowledgeNote: IUPAC priority: carboxylic acid > ester > aldehyde > ketone > alcohol > amine > alkene/alkyne.
